newsitem.title: USA: 3Com expects slowing growth in fiscal Q1. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: 3Com expects slowing growth in fiscal Q1. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT]

text.p: 3Com Corp said Tuesday it expects results for its fiscal first quarter ending in August (corrects month when first quarter ends) to show slower revenue growth because of slowing sales in Europe and work to be done to merge recently acquired U.S. Robotics Corp.
"Sequential growth for us in the summer quarter has been in the single digits," said Chris Paisley, 3Com chief financial officer.
Paisley said the first quarter is traditionally 3Com's slowest because of weak technology sales in the summer.
In a conference call with analysts, Paisley also summarized 3Com's fourth-quarter earnings counting results from U.S. Robotics. He said the data is not official and will be update by late July.

The net income for the combined companies in the fourth quarter was $163 million, or $0.46 cents a share. Fourth-quarter revenue was $1.52 billion. Paisley did not give comparable results for last year's fourth quarter.
